sec: sec:B002: Detect adversarial input / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:B002: Detect adversarial input / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Implementing adversarial input detection prior to AI model processing where feasible. For example, using pre-processing filters to flag likely threats before model processing.

sentences.text: Implementing adversarial input detection prior to AI model processing where feasible.

blocks.id: blk:B002: Detect adversarial input / Control mays/2
blocks.text: Integrating adversarial input detection into existing security operations tooling. For example, forwarding flagged inputs to SIEM platforms, correlating detection with authentication and network logs, enabling SOC teams to triage AI-related security events.
